div.head: EGu Prol., 2
div.ab: ⁊ hig gesetton woruldlice stéora eac, for ðam þingum þe hig wistan, þæt hig elles ne mihton manegum gesteoran, ne fela manna nolde to godcundre bote elles gebugan, swa hy sceolden; ⁊ þa woruldbote hig gesetton gemæne Criste ⁊ cynge, swa hwár swa man nolde godcunde bote gebugan mid rihte to bisceopa dihte.

And they also fixed secular penalties because they knew that otherwise there would be many people whom they would not be able to control, and that otherwise many men would not be willing to submit as they ought to, to the amends required by the church. And they fixed secular amends which would be divided between Christ and the king, wheresoever people would not legally submit to the amends required by the church and determined by the bishop.

⁊ hi gesetton woruldlice stéora eac, for ðam ðingum ðe hig wistan, þæt híg elles ne mihton manegum gesteoran, ne fela manna nolde to godcundre bote elles gebugan, swá he sceolde; ⁊ ða woruldbote hig settan gemæne Criste ⁊ cynge, swa hwár swa man nolde godcunde bote gebugan míd rihte to bisceopa dihte.
